notes.title: 1.2.0 Patch live now
notes.content:
Updates in this patch:

Updated velocity UI/space dust to improve sense of speed and reduce visual noise (either/both can still be disabled)

Reduced the damage inflicted gunships (once they get a bead on you they were a bit too deadly)

Fixed collisions affecting the opposite shield quadrant

Fixed bug where movement speed would default to 0 and prevent locomotion in conversation scenes

Fixed bug that totally nerfed Bok's AI on "Duel"

Fixed bug where missiles launched by player could collide with player shields at launch

Fixed bug where pause menu would not appear after resetting settings to defaults

Fixed bug where changing difficulty during a mission would cause shield UI misbehave

Fixed bug where capital ships could come to a stop way too close to each other

Fixed on-screen keyboard position when setting player name

Fixed Kalon's animation state during the briefing for "Safehouse"

Made enemy missile lock a little harder to break

Alt-tabbing out of the game was causing the mouse cursor to remain visible under certain conditions, the game will try to detect this and hide the cursor


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505735/d31a9654bbe98ca572efe2e9d1fd9b8ccfeede9d.jpg"]
Left Handed Cockpit
This came a little later than planned, but left handed folks can now flip the cockpit. Those using motion controllers will probably also want to flip their controls - because of the way Steam's VR input system works this will need to be done in the SteamVR overlay, but there are some ready-made left handed profiles for each controller uploaded to the Steam workshop and they should show up in the rebind menu. If you want to set things up manually you can also do that in the Steam Overlay.

OpenTrack Support
OpenTrack via UDP is now officially supported. For now the tracking is limited to rotation, but once I know the kinks are worked out I aim to implement positional tracking as well. The settings for this are under the "Misc" tab, you can choose between ports 5550 and 4242 - the IP is locked to 127.0.0.1 for now, but in the future I'll probably make all this and some other settings fully customisable. There is some basic smoothing available (off by default), otherwise the game just takes the raw data from OpenTrack. There is also a rotational multiplier if you want a quick way to get things up and running, but you'll probably prefer to set things up in OpenTrack.

notes.title: 1.1.6 Patch live now
notes.content:
Updates in this patch:


 Added "Easy" difficulty that sits between "Story Mode" and "Normal."
 Added "Low" option to "Team Proficiency" for people who felt like AI teammates are doing too much.
 Team Proficiency now affects aggression as well as skill.
 Improved VR-Gaze input for power management so the yoke will no longer jump around under certain conditions.
 Tweaked tractor beam code to ignore player momentum and draw player in more decisively.
 Added icons to the power controllers to make it clearer what each node represents.
 Removed VR grip-toggle from Throttle/Joystick (if anyone actually liked this, let me know and I'll add it back as an option)
 Added throttle mode selector for "Throttle/Stick" behaviour (explanation for this below*).
 Fixed bug where planetary gravity would still be applied after death/restarting
 Fixed bug that would occasionally not fire the player "landed" trigger and prevented post-mission conversations from working.
 Fixed AI teammates shooting at nothing at the end of "Prison Break."
 Removed pause menu head-rotation matching. The menu will now remain at the "centered" position.
 Main menu will automatically recenter (once) if it detects the player is too far from the ideal position.


*The default throttle behaviour expects a throttle with a central detent and treats everything above the center as 0 to 1 and everything below as 0 to -1 (negative values are treated as reverse thrust). This is fine for most throttles, but in cases where people were using a stick as their throttle, the centered position was being treated as full reverse thrust. This is pretty bad and I'm sorry it took so long to address this issue. There is now a "Throttle Type" selector under "Controls" in the settings menu. If you're using a standard throttle with central detent you don't need to change anything, but if you're using a stick/thumbstick as a throttle then setting this to "Stick" will treat the center position as zero thrust, with forward/back acting as forward/reverse thrust. This setting might also be desirable for throttles with no natural center position.

I'm hoping the tweaks over the last few patches has addressed most concerns about difficulty. The line between "too easy" and "too hard" falls differently for everyone and balancing the game has been a challenge. I'm open to adding more options to tweak difficulty, so if you have specific concerns or suggestions please feel free to contact me at info@urbanlogicgames.com.

notes.title: 1.1.4 Patch live now
notes.content:
Updates in this patch:


 Player's base shield levels increased (explanation for this below)
 Fixed lateral thruster bug in tutorial
 Fixed scrollviews not working when the game is paused
 Removed Gek from briefing in "S.O.S." (he was present despite dialog explicitly stating he's not on board)


Regarding the player's base shields: I made a change shortly after launch that improved the collision detection across the player's shield quadrants. This means that enemy fire is more concentrated on any given quadrant, which is correct, and makes shield management more meaningful - but had the unintended side effect of making enemy fire much more deadly as it was no longer being distributed across multiple quadrants. To remedy this I've increased the player's base shields to bring the game's difficulty back down to where it should be. If you felt like you were dying too often, this was probably why.

notes.title: 1.1.3 Patch live now
notes.content:
Updates in this patch:


  Exposed button bindings for menu navigation and player locomotion.
  Fixed button bind menu resetting the selected controller when a control is rebound.
  Menu scene will now automatically recenter on load (some people were starting in weird places).
  Navmeshes now clear properly before regenerating - this should solve intermittent locomotion issues.
  Exit indicator UI now appears after the first conversation is consumed to make it clearer you can leave and start the next mission at any time.
  Tweaked tractor beam code so that lateral thrusters can't throw you wide of the landing route.
  Added mouselook in VR (off by default, got to VR > VR Locomotion settings panel to turn on)

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.1.1
notes.content:
Completely removed automatic recentering as it was causing issues. The game will now only recenter if the user clicks the recenter button on the menu or recenters in SteamVR.
 Reinstated the option to reverse Yaw/Roll on the VR joystick.
 Option to toggle invert VR joystick Y-axis fixed
 Automatic switching between motion controllers and gamepad/joystick can now be switched off under VR settings, locking to either motion controllers or gamepad/joystick
 Reduced trigger sensitivity to reduce accidental firing on some controllers

If Steam hasn't picked it up yet, restarting Steam should trigger the download.

A note for people using PSVR/Pico/SomniumVR1 headsets, I've made some tweaks to the menu setup. Between this and the auto-centering changes I'm hoping the issues with starting in the floor will be resolved. If they aren't, please ensure your playspace is correctly calibrated in SteamVR. If it is, please try "Quick Calibration" in SteamVR by placing you headset on the floor and press "Quick Calibrate" (Settings > Developer > Quick Calibrate). 

There is a video demonstrating this here: https://youtu.be/5xftDyOG7-E?t=28 
(she's using an older version and the menus look slightly different, but the process is the same).
